Worked for about 6 months. Although in that time, it was obnoxiously loud while making ice. It also has a speaker that beeps when it's full (and it is annoyingly LOUD). The clock/timer function has NEVER worked (I can set it but it is fast and gains about 15 minutes every other day, but it doesn't matter because even with the time function on it chooses to make ice literally whenever it wants to). There is absolutely ZERO manuals or product support included or available online. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. You're better off going with literally any other brand.
The machine works properly. But the ONLY problem it is not making ice cubes at all.

Bought this based on reviews. At first we were very happy with it. The ice cubes melt/shrink if left in the machine, but that wasn't that big a deal. The family and kids loved it overall.
After 5 months it stopped working. The tray full light comes on, when the tray is empty. No customer service info readily available through AMAZON or on the web. Eventually, after a lot of work, got the contact for the service/warranty. Never got a live person and never got a call back or email response. Several months later, finally got a live person, but was told that the device was one week over the warranty period (4 months after we had first contacted them). AMAZON should not let this product be sold without the warranty information and the customer service for the seller being readily available and transparent.

Worked great and my grandkids, husband and myself loved the ice that I bought one for my son and his family for Christmas.  I bought this in April 2016 and it no longer works.  It does not power on at all.  At $125 it's an expensive paper weight.  Do yourself a favor and buy the most inexpensive one since all of the portable ice maker I've purchased (5 different brands in 6 years) only last at the longest 1.5 years.

These KEY REPAIR ITEMS were ordered and arrived as ordered and as anticipated. While the learning process involved in attempting to replace both these part mechanisms myself wasn't aided much by a rather poorly-designed, clearly ill-organized, minimalistic, and WAY-OVERPRICED (DIY) repair manual ($40.00 !), which I could only review with distinct frustration and chagrin, the ordered assemblies here were as advertised and came promptly, so I'm happy with the conscientiousness of the folks who sent them to me, and the online descriptions of them. My only real complaint here is that THE CLUTCH UNIT ITSELF CAN ONLY BE REPLACED WITH SPECIAL ATTENTION PAID TO THE TWO ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL, SEPARATE MOUNTING/RETAINING RING CLIPS, which themselves aren't included with the clutch unit part itself... NO MENTION OF THESE CRITICAL RINGNS/CLIPS IS EVEN MENTIONED HERE when ordered! hENCE, WHY these rings/clips weren't included defies any-and-all reasonable standards of common integrity, courtesy, logic, responsibility, and even duty, as far as I'm concerned! WITHOUT THESE TWO INDISPENSIBLE, ESSENTIAL RINGS/CLIPS EVEN BEING MENTIONED, MUCH LESS INCLUDED WITH THE CLUTCH ITSELF, IT CAN'T BE FIXED! Hence, I can only imagine there were TOO MANY MARKETING CHIEFS, and NOT ENOUGH ACTUAL 'EXPERIENCED' INDIANS INVOLVED HERE in selling the clutch assembly itself... completely, repugnantly clueless to this CLEAR REQUIREMENT ITSELF! The additional fact that these two rings/clips must be relatively cheap

This is FAR better than the original parts in my dishwasher. A quick YouTube video guided me through installation - it took under 15 minutes. I shouldn't have to replace again because these were much better quality parts than original.

The top rack adjuster on our dishwasher was plastic and parts broke twice in a year of buying it. We replaced them with this kit and it was easy to do. No breakage so far. You can tell right away that the parts are superior to the factory installed ones as soon as you pull the top rack out and push it back in. This is what should be in there when you first buy the very expensive dishwasher we have.
Great refill!
Perfect fit on my Bonjour 8-cup stainless steel French press.  And the quality and finish are better than the original screen.  Now I know where to get quality replacement screens!

I bought my Speed Queen washer at a local store, but the price was comparable to Amazon. I bought a Kenmore set 4 years ago and they've both gone out. The washer was top of the line and horrible at cleaning and it literally took me 2 hours to do a load of laundry. I was so glad when it finally died! Have had my Speed Queen 2 days and LOVE it. It is just the basic, no bells and whistles. I can control how much water goes in the machine and my clothes are clean in 20-30 minutes. The agitator and an adequate amount of water is the trick to cleaning clothes. Highly recommend this machine!

I originally bought this unit for a catering function.
I was in the hospital for 3 weeks and when I returned home I really needed this induction unit to work in my bedroom so I could heat food during my recovery. I cannot navigate the stairs down to the kitchen.
Imagine my disappointment when the unit failed on my first use. Cold soup sucks.
The fan in this item rattled and failed the first time I used it.
What a piece of junk.
The problem was compounded by the fact that Amazons return deadline had passed and I was one day late asking for a return.
So now I have a $70.00, 8 lb paperweight.
Update: After contacting Amazon Customer Service and explaining that the unit failed on its first use and explaining the delay to use the unit, Amazon made it right without any further effort. Thank You Amazon.

Previously I've used the Maytag Pur4 UKF8001 filter, and it works great. I thought I try this upgraded model especially since it cost less. Upon installing it, the water ran through very quickly, there was no filtering performed. I thought I had a thread it wrong so I tried it again. That did not help. I also tried the second one because I ordered two to get the cheaper cost. But the second filter also didn't work. I put the old filter back in and it works just fine I just need to order new ones with the filter the clean water again. These EverDrop filters are terrible! This useless filters cost me a lot of money. Don't buy them, stick with the original recommendation for your fridge.
